description.value: The study examined whether increased amygdala activity associated with early life stress was related to depressive symptoms and the impact of negative life-event stress in healthy never-depressed adults, and explored amygdala functional connectivity during negative mood induction.

spans.text: We aimed to test these hypothesis examining whether increased amygdala activity in association with a history of early life stress (ELS) was negatively or positively associated with depressive symptoms and impact of negative life event stress in never-depressed adults.
